recipes.name: Peach Salad
ingredients: 150g/5oz ball buffalo or cow’s milk mozzarella ((1 ball, ok it slightly less or more))
4 slices prosciutto ((or jamon serrano, about 70g/2.5 oz; for other subs see Note 1))
instructions: Cut peach: Halve peaches. Remove seed. Cut each half into half again. If your peaches are really large, cut each half into thirds.
Dressing: Combined dressing ingredients in a jar and shake well.
Toss rocket in ~2 tbsp of dressing.
Assemble: Arrange rocket, peaches, mozzarella on a large plate or platter. Drape prosciutto around salad. Drizzle remaining oil over the salad. Serve!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Other cold cuts you can substitute: thinly sliced pancetta, coppa/capocollo, bresaola. For a non-meat option, sliced marinated artichokes are excellent in this salad.
